CONTROLLED FAILURE

A changed page
needs an explicit decision.

A mismatched control stops replay. The operator reviews and approves a new recipe. Last-good data stays available.

01

Bounded execution

Known local destinations and permitted operations.

02

No bad publication

Wrong dates, missing reports or failed checks cannot become new financial totals.

03

Jev is conditional

DEFINITIONS BEFORE CLAIMS

Sales are measured.
The model is disclosed.

Demo net sales = item sales − refunds. Shipping collected, taxes and fees are excluded from that metric.

01

Labor assumptions

Upright: 2 h/store/day, then 3 h from Sept 24. Cash Monkey: 0.5 h/store/day.

02

Cost assumptions

Source fees; invented $3.50 shipping/record and $20/h labor.

03

Contribution margin

Net sales less fees, modeled shipping and labor. Excludes overhead and taxes.
